origin: docs/CWE-117/java Common Pitfalls: Assuming SLF4J placeholders alone block CR/LF

finding.name: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs
finding.summary: a request parameter is concatenated into a log message

trap: Converting the concatenation to an SLF4J placeholder. That keeps the value separate at the API level but does not stop a raw CR/LF reaching the output line unless the appender uses an encoding-aware layout rather than a text PatternLayout.
must_preserve: The failure branch still logs at ERROR with the caught exception attached, and still returns 401. The success branch still logs the username at INFO and returns 200.
